properties.name: quartz.scheduler.instance-id
properties.description: Scheduler instance id. Defaults to AUTO when clustered, NON_CLUSTERED otherwise.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.misfire-threshold
properties.description: How late a trigger may fire before it is considered a misfire. Unitless numbers are milliseconds. Examples: 120s, 2m, 120000ms, 120000.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.idle-wait-time
properties.description: How long the scheduler thread sleeps when no triggers are ready. Must be at least 1s. Unitless numbers are milliseconds. Examples: 30s, 30000ms, 30000.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.batch-time-window
properties.description: Fire-ahead window when acquiring a batch of triggers. Unitless numbers are milliseconds. Examples: 0s, 500ms, 500.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.clustered
properties.description: Multi-JVM clustering. Requires a Mongo replica set and NTP.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.cluster-checkin-interval
properties.description: Cluster check-in interval. Unitless numbers are milliseconds. Examples: 15s, 15000ms, 15000.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.properties
properties.description: Extra org.quartz.* keys applied first. Typed quartz.scheduler.* Duration fields win.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.thread-pool.thread-count
properties.description: Worker threads / max concurrent virtual jobs.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.thread-pool.thread-priority
properties.description: SimpleThreadPool thread priority. Unused when virtual is true.

properties.name: quartz.scheduler.thread-pool.virtual
properties.description: When true, use VirtualThreadPool instead of SimpleThreadPool. thread-count still caps concurrency.
